data.source_title: Performance evaluation of an emergency department in Rio de Janeiro: a hybrid approach using Discrete Events Simulation and Data Envelopment Analysis
data.locator: Methods, Table 2 (timestamp availability); Results, Table 6 (mean service time and 95% CI by shift).
data.source_setting: Single emergency department in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; reception, nurse triage and emergency consultation; two shifts (T1 daytime, T2 nighttime).
data.source_period: Source records February 1, 2022 to September 30, 2023, excluding August 2023; exact stage fitting window not specified.
data.source_n: Administrative encounter records; stage-specific n not reported. Triage service-duration field was missing in 55.07%; consultation duration missing in 16.46%.
data.quantity: Observed mean nurse triage service time, T1 and T2
data.unit: minutes per triage service; 95% confidence intervals
data.source_evidence_basis: Primary observational hospital-record study reports shift-stratified empirical means and confidence intervals. These are service durations, not queue waits; the paper reports a high missingness rate for the source duration field.
data.limitations: Single Brazilian hospital and shift-specific results; over half of triage duration values were missing. No empirical distribution family or individual quantiles are reported, and this mean must not be converted into one.
data.inferred_scenario_use: External reference for a triage service-time mean and uncertainty interval in sensitivity scenarios; do not use as an RWJ measurement or fabricate a service-time distribution.

data.locator: Results, Table 6 (average length of stay at reception by shift); Methods, Table 2 (timestamp availability).
data.source_setting: Single emergency department in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; front desk/reception stage, two shifts (T1 daytime, T2 nighttime).
data.source_period: Source records February 1, 2022 to September 30, 2023, excluding August 2023; exact stage fitting window not specified.
data.source_n: Administrative encounter records; reception stage n not reported; reception timestamp field missing in 16.86%.
data.quantity: Observed average length of stay at reception, T1 and T2
data.source_evidence_basis: Primary hospital-record paper gives empirical shift means and confidence intervals. The table labels the measure reception length of stay; it should not be assumed to be clerk touch time alone.
data.limitations: Single Brazilian hospital; reception time definition may include non-service time. Stage n is not given, and the reception timestamp field has missing records.
data.inferred_scenario_use: External proxy for reception-stage elapsed time; keep separate from clerk service time and queue waiting, and do not transfer as RWJ timing.

data.source_title: Performance evaluation of an emergency department in Rio de Janeiro: a hybrid approach using Discrete Events Simulation and Data Envelopment Analysis
data.locator: Table 7; Appendix 2 input fits; Appendix 6 observed-versus-simulated comparisons.
data.source_setting: Single emergency department in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; simulation distinguishes daytime T1 and nighttime T2 triage processes.
data.source_period: Source records February 1, 2022 to September 30, 2023, excluding August 2023; exact stage fitting window not specified.
data.source_n: Underlying stage sample n not reported; triage service-time field missing in 55.07% of the record set.
data.quantity: Triage service-time specification used in the DES model
data.unit: minutes; ARENA LOGN/EXPO parameter units and convention as stated by paper
data.distribution_family: T1 shifted lognormal; T2 shifted exponential
data.parameterization: Table 7 reports T1 1.5 + LOGN(1.86, 1.32), but the appendix fit table reports T1 1.5 + LOGN(1.05, 0.848); both report T2 1.5 + EXPO(1.7). Expressions are copied as printed; ARENA parameter convention is not reinterpreted. Follow-up manual inspection clarifies LOGN as arithmetic mean/SD and EXPO as mean; see calibration-timing-arena-logn-convention. Neither T1 expression is selected.
data.fit_method: Input Analyzer selected candidate fits. Appendix 2 has test statistics and parenthetical <0.05 annotations. Their formatting is ambiguous; Appendix 6 separately concerns observed-versus-simulated lengths of stay.
data.source_evidence_basis: Source reports candidate simulation inputs. The earlier extraction claim that the body says all fit p-values exceeded 0.05 was not substantiated by the full English PDF and is withdrawn.
data.limitations: Stage sample size and fitting subset remain unknown, with substantial missingness. Fit validity is not established; T1 triage expressions conflict between Table 7 and Appendix 2. Local applicability is unestablished.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Keep blocked until fit validity and source ambiguities are resolved; see calibration timing audit. Do not transfer to RWJ.
data.correction_note: 2026-10-10: withdrew unsupported body p>0.05 claim; corrected source period. Original values retained, quantitative block unchanged.
